intro: We list {{count}} MBA / PGDM college in Odisha where our records show a highest package of at least ₹{{threshold}} lakh: KIIT University. XIMB's flagship MBA HR 2024 highest of ₹30 LPA is below this cut, so the earlier executive-MBA row is no longer used.

These MBA colleges in Odisha with ₹50 lakh highest package should still be read against the official NIRF list. XIMB is no longer on this threshold page, because its flagship MBA record in our file is below ₹50 lakh.
listLead: XIMB's MBA HR card for 2024 shows a highest package of ₹30 LPA in our file, which is below this threshold. An older executive-MBA row is no longer used to qualify the college, so only KIIT remains on this page.
snapshot: XIM University is 45th in the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking. KIIT is 68th. Those ranks are for the university, and you should still match the placement report to the exact programme.
KIIT's MBA row for 2023 shows an average of ₹7 LPA and a highest of ₹63 LPA in our records. That gap is wide, so the official report is the safer source.
firstCollegesLead: XIMB is no longer on this threshold list. Confirm fees and the latest official flagship MBA report on the XIM University site if that is the programme you will join.

compare.heading: How to read highest-package figures in Odisha
paragraphs: A two-year MBA, an executive MBA and a university MBA at KIIT should be compared only after you line up the programme, the year and the average.
bullets: Check whether the qualifying XIMB figure is for the executive MBA or a two-year MBA.
Use the average beside the highest, especially at KIIT, where our 2023 average is ₹7 LPA.
Confirm the latest official placement report and the current admission notice.

faqs.question: Which MBA colleges in Odisha with ₹50 lakh highest package are listed here?
faqs.answer: {{count}} college in Bhubaneswar: KIIT University, on a 2023 MBA record in our file. XIMB's flagship MBA record is below this threshold, so it is not listed here.

faqs.question: What are the official NIRF 2025 ranks?
faqs.answer: XIM University is 45th and KIIT is 68th in the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking. Use those 2025 ranks rather than any older number on a card.

faqs.question: Why does the XIMB MBA HR card show a highest package below ₹50 lakh?
faqs.answer: That 2024 MBA HR row shows a highest of ₹30 LPA in our file, which is below this threshold. The earlier executive-MBA row is no longer used, so XIMB does not appear on this page.

faqs.question: Is KIIT's ₹63 Lakh highest package typical?
faqs.answer: No. In the same 2023 MBA row, the average is ₹7 LPA. The highest is a single top offer and should be confirmed in the official placement report.
